text: Weekly Atlas update: fleet dashboard and scheduling are feature-complete in staging. OTA update scheduling is ~70%. Umbrella Freight has been on the beta for 2 weeks with 30 robots.
Umbrella feedback from yesterday's call: they love the map view, but the alert feed is noisy (low-battery alerts every 5 min). They'd like alert grouping.
Alert grouping mock is ready, will share in #product. Debounce + group by site.
Platform side: dashboard p95 load is 1.4s for a 120-robot fleet. Target was 2s, so we're good. Load testing 500 robots next week.
Billing note: Atlas per-robot metering will go through PayStream once Billing v2 lands. Until then legacy billing handles Umbrella's beta at $0.
Thanks <@U06MEI>, that's exactly what finance asked.
